title: Implement Out-of-Band Fable 5.1 Recovery Launcher
instructions: Append after the previous chunk without editing earlier lines. Satisfy SRS-412-08-FR-008: The Watchdog shall initiate self-healing by launching an out-of-band `claude.exe` Fable 5.1 recovery process with the Evidence Bundle. Build an argv list (no shell=True), launch detached, and pass the bundle path. The executable path must be configurable and recovery must be disable-able (--no-recovery). Keep the existing --claude-exe flag so tests launch a real stand-in executable instead of claude.exe.
